title: General SQL Database Connection Troubleshooting
content: When an application cannot connect to a SQL database, first identify which database engine is being used. Check whether the database service is running, verify the hostname and port, and inspect network connectivity and firewall settings. Do not assume the database is PostgreSQL, MySQL, or Microsoft SQL Server unless the error or system configuration confirms it.

title: PostgreSQL Connection Troubleshooting
content: For PostgreSQL connection failures, check whether the PostgreSQL server is running. Verify the hostname, port, and connection settings. Check firewall rules and PostgreSQL server logs.

title: Request Timeout Troubleshooting
content: Check server response times, network latency, and timeout settings. Investigate slow database queries or overloaded services when relevant.

title: Memory Troubleshooting
content: Check available RAM and GPU memory, application memory usage, and possible memory leaks. Identify processes consuming excessive memory.
